title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向长程智能体强化学习的树感知后验蒸馏

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, process reward models, or on-policy distillation, but they rely on a value network, step-level annotations, or a stronger external teacher that increase training complexity. Meanwhile, importance sampling and clipping mitigate policy drift, but they do not specify a finite target that stops sequential updates from overshooting. In this work, we introduce TreeOPSD, a critic-free, tree-aware posterior self-distillation framework for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning. Treating each interaction turn as a tree node, TreeOPSD branches alternative continuations from shared prefixes and recursively backs up terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit. It then maps each credit to a closed-form, bounded teacher distribution parameterized by the likelihood ratio relative to the frozen behavior policy. Minimizing the divergence between this teacher and the student policy recovers the policy-gradient direction as the tangent at the behavior policy while bounding updates toward a finite target across sequential mini-batches. Empirically, TreeOPSD improves agentic capabilities across several competitive benchmarks and model scales, especially for long-horizon tasks, e.g., raising the average accuracy of Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 by 4.97 points over GRPO on the Deep Research setting.
paragraphs.zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习已成为大语言模型一种可扩展的后训练范式。 然而，在长程交互上训练智能体面临两个挑战：仅使用终局奖励会使回合级信用分配稀疏且方差高，而在固定采样批次上进行顺序小批量更新会随着当前策略偏离行为策略而引入策略陈旧问题。 现有方法通过学习评论家、过程奖励模型或在线策略蒸馏获得更密集的信用信号，但它们依赖价值网络、步骤级标注或更强的外部教师模型，从而增加了训练复杂度。 与此同时，重要性采样和裁剪可以缓解策略漂移，但它们并未指定一个有限的目标来阻止顺序更新过度偏离。 在本工作中，我们提出 TreeOPSD，一个无需评论家、面向树的隐式后验自蒸馏框架，用于长程智能体强化学习。 TreeOPSD 将每个交互回合视为树节点，从共享前缀分支出备选后续路径，并将终局奖励递归回传为隐式的回合级信用。 随后，它将每个信用映射为一个闭式、有界的教师分布，该分布由相对于冻结行为策略的似然比参数化。 通过最小化该教师分布与学生策略之间的散度，可以在行为策略处将策略梯度方向恢复为切线方向，同时在顺序小批量更新之间将更新限制在有限目标内。 实验表明，TreeOPSD 在多个竞争性基准和不同模型规模上提升了智能体能力，尤其是在长程任务上，例如在 Deep Research 设置下将 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 相对于 GRPO 的平均准确率提升了 4.97 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) has emerged as a central post-training paradigm for large language models (LLMs), using outcome rewards to incentivize reasoning or environment interactions on complex problem-solving tasks. While reasoning-oriented RLVR typically learns from Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rollouts, agentic RL ( Yao et al., 2022 ) extends this paradigm to long-horizon, multi-turn trajectories in which reasoning is interleaved with actions and environment observations. As the interaction horizon grows, a single terminal reward provides increasingly sparse and high-variance supervision across intermediate turns: broadcasting one trajectory-level advantage over the entire rollout over-credits unhelpful actions in successful trajectories and penalizes useful steps in failed ones ( Arjona-Medina et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . At the same time, updating the policy across sequential mini-batches within each rollout batch induces policy staleness as the current policy departs from the behavior policy ( Zheng et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）（Shao et al., 2024；Guo et al., 2025）已成为大语言模型（LLM）的核心后训练范式，它利用结果奖励来激励模型在复杂问题解决任务上进行推理或环境交互。 面向推理的 RLVR 通常从思维链（CoT） rollout 中学习，而智能体强化学习（Yao et al., 2022）则将这一范式扩展到长时程、多轮轨迹，其中推理与动作及环境观察交替进行。 随着交互时程的增长，单一的终端奖励在中间各轮次上提供的监督日益稀疏且方差很高：将一个轨迹级优势广播到整个 rollout 上，会过度奖励成功轨迹中无用的动作，并惩罚失败轨迹中有用的步骤（Arjona-Medina et al., 2019；Li et al., 2026a）。 与此同时，在每个 rollout 批次内的多个顺序小批次上更新策略，会导致策略陈旧化，因为当前策略逐渐偏离行为策略（Zheng et al., 2025a）。

paragraphs.en: To address the credit assignment problem, actor–critic methods such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) estimate token-level advantages with a learned critic, which is difficult to train accurately and susceptible to value flattening ( Li et al., 2026c ) . Process reward models (PRMs) ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) provide step-level rewards but require process annotations, and summing them as discounted returns is vulnerable to reward hacking ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . On-policy distillation (OPD) ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) provides dense token-level supervision on student rollouts at the cost of querying a stronger external teacher. Extending OPD, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Kaur et al., 2026 ) constructs a self-teacher by conditioning the model on privileged context (e.g., reference solutions), which relies on task-specific heuristics and can yield unstable supervision. These limitations leave open how to derive dense intermediate credit directly from terminal verifier rewards. Sampling independent trajectories confounds all turns along each rollout, whereas multi-turn interaction exposes discrete turn-level prefixes as natural branching points. Branching alternative continuations from a shared prefix fixes the preceding history to isolate how subsequent decisions affect terminal outcomes, forming a rollout tree on which recursive backup converts terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit without auxiliary value or reward models ( Ji et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决信用分配问题，诸如近端策略优化（PPO）（Schulman et al., 2017）等 actor–critic 方法通过学习到的 critic 估计 token 级优势，但 critic 难以准确训练，且容易出现价值扁平化（Li et al., 2026c）。 过程奖励模型（PRM）（Lightman et al., 2024）能够提供步骤级奖励，但需要过程标注，且将其按折扣回报求和的方式容易受到奖励破解（reward hacking）的影响（Cheng et al., 2026）。 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）（Agarwal et al., 2024; Gu et al., 2024）在学生模型的 rollout 上提供密集的 token 级监督，但代价是需要查询一个更强的外部教师模型。 作为 OPD 的扩展，在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）（Zhao et al., 2026; Kaur et al., 2026）通过让模型以特权上下文（例如参考解答）为条件来构建自教师，但这依赖于任务特定的启发式规则，且可能产生不稳定的监督信号。 这些局限使得如何直接从终端验证器奖励中推导密集的中间信用这一问题仍未解决。 采样独立的轨迹会将每条 rollout 中的所有回合混在一起，而多轮交互则将离散的回合级前缀暴露为天然的分支点。 从共享前缀出发分支出多个备选后续，可以将先前的历史固定下来，从而隔离后续决策对终端结果的影响，由此形成一棵 rollout 树；在该树上进行递归回溯，无需辅助的价值模型或奖励模型即可将终端奖励转化为隐式的回合级信用（Ji et al., 2026; Zou et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: We derive closed-form, bounded turn-level target distributions via an affine map of backed-up credit relative to the frozen behavior policy. Because this affine map commutes with tree backup, matching the backed-up parent target is gradient-equivalent to aggregating descendant distillation losses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过对冻结行为策略的回传信用施加仿射变换，推导出封闭形式且有界的回合级目标分布。 由于该仿射变换与树回传可交换，匹配回传的父节点目标在梯度上等价于聚合后代蒸馏损失。

paragraphs.en: We formulate a Forward-KL posterior distillation objective whose tangent at the behavior policy recovers the tree policy gradient, while its student–teacher residual vanishes at the target and reverses sign upon overshoot to stabilize sequential mini-batch optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一个前向KL后验蒸馏目标，其在行为策略处的切向量可恢复树策略梯度，同时其师生残差在目标处为零并在过冲时反号，从而稳定顺序小批量优化。

paragraphs.en: Across sequential mini-batch updates, the ascent gradient − ∇ θ ℒ x ​ ( θ ) -\nabla_{\theta}\mathcal{L}_{x}(\theta) satisfies three properties:
paragraphs.zh: 在连续的小批量更新过程中，上升梯度 − ∇ θ ℒ x ​ ( θ ) -\nabla_{\theta}\mathcal{L}_{x}(\theta) 满足以下三个性质：

paragraphs.en: Exact on-policy tangent: At the behavior policy π θ = π θ old \pi_{\theta}=\pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}} , we have r θ , i = 1 r_{\theta,i}=1 and p θ , i = 1 / 2 p_{\theta,i}=1/2 , so the drift correction vanishes and − ∇ θ ℒ x ​ ( θ old ) = g x tree -\nabla_{\theta}\mathcal{L}_{x}(\theta_{\mathrm{old}})=g_{x}^{\mathrm{tree}} exactly recovers Eq. 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 精确的严格同策略切点：在行为策略 π θ = π θ old \pi_{\theta}=\pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}} 处，我们有 r θ , i = 1 r_{\theta,i}=1 且 p θ , i = 1 / 2 p_{\theta,i}=1/2 ，因此漂移修正项消失，− ∇ θ ℒ x ​ ( θ old ) = g x tree -\nabla_{\theta}\mathcal{L}_{x}(\theta_{\mathrm{old}})=g_{x}^{\mathrm{tree}} 恰好还原了式 6。

paragraphs.en: Bounded additive drift cancellation: As π θ \pi_{\theta} drifts away from π θ old \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}} on subsequent mini-batches, the additive correction − τ ⁡ ( p θ , i − 1 / 2 ) -\tau(p_{\theta,i}-1/2) counteracts the policy shift, remaining Lipschitz in s θ , i s_{\theta,i} and uniformly bounded for all r θ , i ∈ ( 0 , ∞ ) r_{\theta,i}\in(0,\infty) without the exponential variance of multiplicative importance ratios ( Ionides, 2008 ; Liu et al., 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 有界加性漂移消除：随着 π θ \pi_{\theta} 在后续小批次上逐渐偏离 π θ old \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}}，加性修正项 − τ ⁡ ( p θ , i − 1 / 2 ) -\tau(p_{\theta,i}-1/2) 会抵消策略偏移，其在 s θ , i s_{\theta,i} 上保持 Lipschitz 连续，并且对所有 r θ , i ∈ ( 0 , ∞ ) r_{\theta,i}\in(0,\infty) 一致有界，而不会出现乘性重要性比率的指数级方差问题（Ionides, 2008；Liu et al., 2018）。

paragraphs.en: Finite-target equilibrium and sign reversal: Γ i ​ ( s θ , i ) \Gamma_{i}(s_{\theta,i}) vanishes once r θ , i r_{\theta,i} reaches r i ⋆ r_{i}^{\star} and reverses sign if earlier mini-batches push the turn past r i ⋆ r_{i}^{\star} , whereas fixed-credit updates keep V i V_{i} unchanged regardless of drift.
paragraphs.zh: 有限目标均衡与符号反转：Γ i ​ ( s θ , i ) \Gamma_{i}(s_{\theta,i}) 在 r θ , i r_{\theta,i} 达到 r i ⋆ r_{i}^{\star} 时归零，且若较早的小批次将轮次推过 r i ⋆ r_{i}^{\star} 则符号反转，而固定信用更新则无论漂移如何都保持 V i V_{i} 不变。

paragraphs.en: We compare TreeOPSD with four baselines. (1) ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022 ) : evaluates the base model in the same multi-turn agent and tool scaffold. (2) GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) : normalizes terminal rewards over complete rollouts from each prompt. (3) GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025b ) : replaces token-level importance ratios with a sequence-level ratio while retaining group-relative terminal advantages. (4) TreePO : uses the same initialize-then-expand trees, likelihood-weighted turn credits V i V_{i} , prompt normalization, and optimizer blocks as TreeOPSD, but applies the fixed ascent coefficient V i / L x V_{i}/L_{x} throughout optimization instead of matching a finite posterior target. GRPO and GSPO use G = 8 G=8 rollouts per prompt, and both tree methods use M = 4 M=4 initial rollouts and N = 2 N=2 continuations per initial rollout to match that budget under expectation.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 and Figure 4 show TreeOPSD with the highest Multi-Hop QA and Deep Research averages at both scales. TreePO is trained on the same initialize-then-expand trees, the same credits V i V_{i} , and the same optimizer blocks, so the two methods differ only in how that credit is used. TreePO keeps the collection-time coefficient V i / L x V_{i}/L_{x} on every later block. TreeOPSD matches a frozen turn teacher and recomputes the residual as π θ \pi_{\theta} moves. TreeOPSD improves both Multi-Hop QA and Deep Research, with a larger gain on the longer-horizon Deep Research setting, where it raises the average over TreePO from 13.07 to 15.45 for Qwen3-4B and from 17.59 to 21.20 for Qwen3-30B-A3B. On that longer horizon, later blocks more often update a policy that has already left π θ old \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}} . paragraphs.en: We presented TreeOPSD, a critic-free posterior self-distillation framework for long-horizon agentic RLVR. It backs sparse terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit on a shared-prefix tree and mitigates policy drift by matching a finite behavior-relative teacher with Forward KL. The affine target commutes with tree backup, and the distillation gradient recovers tree policy gradient at the behavior policy, then stops or reverses after overshoot, so a rollout batch supports sequential updates without a learned critic, process labels, or an external teacher. TreeOPSD improves over matched-budget baselines at both scales on Multi-Hop QA and Deep Research, and the gain is much larger on the longer-horizon setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 TreeOPSD，一个面向长程智能体 RLVR 的无评论家后验自蒸馏框架。 它将稀疏的终局奖励回传为共享前缀树上的隐式轮级信用，并通过与一个有限的行为相对教师进行前向 KL 匹配来缓解策略漂移。 该仿射目标与树回传可交换，且蒸馏梯度在行为策略处恢复为树策略梯度，在过冲之后停止或反转，因此一次 rollout 批次无需学习评论家、过程标签或外部教师即可支持序贯更新。 在 Multi-Hop QA 和 Deep Research 上，TreeOPSD 在两个规模下均优于同等预算的基线，且在更长程设定中的提升要大得多。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) trains language models from automatically checked outcomes and has produced strong reasoning policies in mathematics, coding, and other rule-based tasks. PPO remains a general policy-gradient backbone ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) , while GRPO removes the learned value model by estimating advantages from response groups ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Later variants alter the granularity of importance weighting ( Zheng et al., 2025b ) or organize comparisons within larger groups ( Feng et al., 2025 ) . RLVR has also moved from complete reasoning responses to agents that interleave language, tools, and environment observations ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . In this setting, a single terminal advantage supervises a sequence of search queries, tool calls, and answer decisions ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025d ; Dong et al., 2026 ) . TreeOPSD focuses on this turn-structured regime and derives intermediate targets directly from verifiable outcomes rather than introducing a learned critic or process labels.
paragraphs.zh: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）（Shao et al., 2024；Guo et al., 2025；Yu et al., 2026）利用自动检查的结果来训练语言模型，已在数学、编程及其他基于规则的任务中产生了强大的推理策略。 PPO 仍然是通用的策略梯度主干（Schulman et al., 2017），而 GRPO 通过从响应组中估计优势来移除学习到的价值模型（Shao et al., 2024）。 后续变体改变了重要性加权的粒度（Zheng et al., 2025b），或在更大的组内组织比较（Feng et al., 2025）。 RLVR 也已从完整的推理响应扩展到在语言、工具与环境观察之间交替进行的智能体（Yao et al., 2022）。 在这种设定下，单一的终端优势监督一系列搜索查询、工具调用与答案决策（Jin et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2025d；Dong et al., 2026）。 TreeOPD 关注这种按轮次组织的场景，直接从可验证结果中推导中间目标，而不是引入学习到的评论家模型或过程标签。

paragraphs.en: Tree search lets language models compare continuations from a shared history instead of drawing only independent complete trajectories. At inference time, Tree-of-Thought ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , language-agent search ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , and MCTS-style procedures ( Feng et al., 2023 ) use branching to improve planning or answer selection. Offline methods turn reasoning trees into supervised or preference data ( Lai et al., 2024 ) , while online methods bring the tree into RL for exploration, value estimation, local comparisons, or rollout allocation ( Hou et al., 2025 ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Zong et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026a ) . These approaches differ in where branches are collected and how sibling outcomes become gradients. TreeOPSD takes a shared-prefix tree as input, backs terminal evidence into turn credit, and converts that credit into a finite target for the current policy. Its contribution lies in optimizing the acquired tree rather than choosing where the tree should branch.
paragraphs.zh: 树搜索使语言模型能够从共享历史出发比较多种延续，而不是只生成相互独立的完整轨迹。 在推理阶段，思维树（Tree-of-Thought）（Yao et al., 2023）、语言智能体搜索（Zhou et al., 2023）以及 MCTS 风格的方法（Feng et al., 2023）利用分支来改进规划或答案选择。 离线方法将推理树转化为监督数据或偏好数据（Lai et al., 2024），而在线方法则把树引入强化学习，用于探索、价值估计、局部比较或 rollout 分配（Hou et al., 2025; Ji et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2025b; Zong et al., 2026; Dong et al., 2026; Zou et al., 2026a）。 这些方法的差异在于在哪里收集分支，以及如何将兄弟节点的结果转化为梯度。 TreeOPSD 以一棵共享前缀的树作为输入，将末端证据回传为轮次信用，并将该信用转化为当前策略的有限目标。 它的贡献在于优化已获得的树，而不是决定树应当在哪里分支。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of work reduces rollout cost by deciding which examples receive sampling budget. Offline curation fixes the training set before optimization ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Online methods filter prompts whose rollouts are uninformative ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Bae et al., 2026 ) or predict prompt difficulty before sampling ( Zheng et al., 2025c ; Qu et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Mao et al., 2026a ; Qu et al., 2026b ) , much as automated model evaluation predicts test accuracy from unlabeled data ( Peng et al., 2024 ) . POPO replays effective groups from earlier policies in place of zero-variance groups ( Mao et al., 2026b ) , and budget allocation varies the number of rollouts per prompt ( Li et al., 2025b ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . In supervised fine-tuning, online batch selection scores samples by utility and diversity ( Zou et al., 2025a ) . TRACE extends allocation from prompt roots to turn-level prefixes with a shared success predictor ( Zou et al., 2026a ) . These methods decide which rollouts to acquire, and TreeOPSD decides how an acquired tree updates the policy, so the two compose without changing the teacher in Section 3.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 另一条平行的工作线通过决定哪些样本获得采样预算来降低 rollout 成本。 离线筛选在优化开始前就固定训练集（Ye et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025a；Wang et al., 2025）。 在线方法会过滤 rollout 无信息量的提示词（Yu et al., 2026；Bae et al., 2026），或在采样前预测提示词难度（Zheng et al., 2025c；Qu et al., 2025；Gao et al., 2025；Mao et al., 2026a；Qu et al., 2026b），这与自动化模型评估从无标注数据预测测试准确率的方式类似（Peng et al., 2024）。 POPO 用早期策略中的有效组替代零方差组（Mao et al., 2026b），预算分配则改变每个提示词的 rollout 数量（Li et al., 2025b；Yao et al., 2026）。 在监督微调中，在线批次选择按效用和多样性对样本打分（Zou et al., 2025a）。 TRACE 借助共享的成功预测器，把分配从提示词根节点扩展到轮次级前缀（Zou et al., 2026a）。 这些方法决定获取哪些 rollout，而 TreeOPSD 决定已获取的树如何更新策略，因此二者可以组合，且无需改变 3.2 节中的教师模型。

paragraphs.en: Credit assignment under delayed rewards is a long-standing RL problem. Temporal-difference learning ( Sutton et al., 1998 ) , potential-based shaping ( Ng et al., 1999 ) , and return decomposition ( Arjona-Medina et al., 2019 ) provide denser signals by estimating state values or redistributing terminal returns. For language-model reasoning, process supervision and process reward models score intermediate steps ( Uesato et al., 2022 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , and recent work derives progress signals from Monte Carlo continuations, answer likelihoods, or implicit process objectives ( Setlur et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) . Long-horizon LLM methods further use trajectory graphs ( Li et al., 2026a ) , vine-style continuations ( Kazemnejad et al., 2025 ) , or alternative reward aggregation ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) to localize responsibility within a rollout. Rollout trees ( Ji et al., 2026 ; Zong et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) provide a related source of counterfactual evidence because sibling suffixes keep the prefix fixed while varying the future. TreeOPSD backs this evidence through the sampled tree and preserves value shared by multiple useful continuations instead of removing it through sibling centering.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟奖励下的信用分配是一个长期存在的强化学习问题。时序差分学习（Sutton et al., 1998）、基于势函数的塑形（Ng et al., 1999）以及回报分解（Arjona-Medina et al., 2019）通过估计状态价值或重新分配终端回报来提供更密集的信号。对于语言模型推理，过程监督和过程奖励模型会对中间步骤进行评分（Uesato et al., 2022；Lightman et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024），近期的工作则从蒙特卡洛延续、答案似然或隐式过程目标中推导进度信号（Setlur et al., 2025；Yuan et al., 2024）。长时程大语言模型方法进一步利用轨迹图（Li et al., 2026a）、藤蔓式延续（Kazemnejad et al., 2025）或替代性奖励聚合（Cheng et al., 2026），以在单次 rollout 中定位责任来源。Rollout 树（Ji et al., 2026；Zong et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2025b）提供了一种相关的反事实证据来源，因为兄弟后缀在保持前缀不变的同时改变未来。TreeOPSD 通过采样树来利用这种证据，并保留多个有用延续所共享的价值，而不是像兄弟中心化那样将其移除。

paragraphs.en: KL-regularized RL ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , maximum-a-posteriori policy optimization ( Abdolmaleki et al., 2018 ) , and preference optimization ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Meng et al., 2024 ) improve a policy while anchoring it to a reference distribution. Mirror-descent and mirror-ascent analyses make the corresponding target-and-projection structure explicit ( Beck and Teboulle, 2003 ; Vaswani et al., 2022 ; Asad et al., 2025 ) , and recent work applies this view to group-based language-model updates on finite response sets ( Qu et al., 2026a ) . On-policy distillation instead trains on student-generated samples using a teacher distribution ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Kaur et al., 2026 ) or privileged continuation information ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) . TreeOPSD joins these perspectives at the turn level. It represents each observed turn by a behavior-relative Bernoulli, related to relative density-ratio estimation ( Yamada et al., 2013 ; Cranmer et al., 2015 ) and contrastive source classification ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , then obtains a closed-form teacher from backed-up credit and matches it with Forward KL. Independent turn targets avoid treating a sparse sibling sample as a closed continuation simplex, while the finite teacher supplies a destination that fixed-credit policy gradients do not specify.
paragraphs.zh: KL 正则化强化学习（Ouyang et al., 2022）、最大后验策略优化（Abdolmaleki et al., 2018）以及偏好优化（Rafailov et al., 2023; Meng et al., 2024）在改进策略的同时将其锚定于某个参考分布。 镜像下降与镜像上升分析使相应的“目标加投影”结构得以显式呈现（Beck and Teboulle, 2003; Vaswani et al., 2022; Asad et al., 2025），且近期工作将这一视角应用于有限回复集合上的基于分组的语言模型更新（Qu et al., 2026a）。 在线蒸馏则使用教师分布在学生生成的样本上进行训练（Agarwal et al., 2024; Gu et al., 2024; Zhao et al., 2026; Kaur et al., 2026），或利用特权的续写信息（Nguyen et al., 2026）。 TreeOPSD 在轮次层面将上述这些视角结合在一起。 它将每个观察到的轮次表示为一个相对于行为的伯努利变量，这与相对密度比估计（Yamada et al., 2013; Cranmer et al., 2015）以及对比式来源分类（Goodfellow et al., 2014; Chen et al., 2024）相关，随后由回传的信用得到闭式教师分布，并用前向 KL 与之匹配。 独立的轮次目标避免将稀疏的同级样本视为封闭的续写单纯形，而有限教师分布则提供了固定信用策略梯度所未能指明的目的地。

paragraphs.en: Tree-based agent RL involves three decisions that are often coupled in one algorithm. A rollout procedure first decides which prompts or prefixes receive continuations. A credit-assignment rule then maps terminal outcomes on that tree to turn values. Policy optimization uses those values to update the current LLM. TreeOPSD handles the last step: it takes a sampled tree and normalized child weights, converts the backed-up values into behavior-relative targets, and matches the current policy to those targets. The same target construction can be paired with random branching, learned rollout allocation, or other tree samplers.
paragraphs.zh: 基于树的智能体强化学习涉及三项决策，它们在单个算法中往往是相互耦合的。 展开流程首先决定哪些提示或前缀会获得续写。 然后由信用分配规则将该树上的终端结果映射为各轮次的数值。 策略优化利用这些数值来更新当前的大语言模型。 TreeOPSD 处理最后一步：它接收一棵采样得到的树和归一化的子节点权重，将回传的数值转换为相对于行为的目标，并使当前策略与这些目标相匹配。 同样的目标构建方式也可以与随机分支、学习式展开分配或其他树采样器相结合。

paragraphs.en: A categorical distribution over sampled siblings is invariant to a common shift of their logits or rewards. It can rank the observed continuations, but it removes value shared by all of them. This is appropriate when the sampled set is treated as a closed choice set. In an LLM, however, a few sampled siblings cover only a small part of the continuation space. If every observed sibling is useful relative to the behavior policy, a sibling-normalized update cannot raise them together. TreeOPSD instead assigns each observed turn its own behavior-relative Bernoulli target, allowing the shared policy to increase all useful turns while retaining their relative differences. Each target describes where one observed turn should move relative to its behavior likelihood. These targets do not form a normalized action distribution over the full vocabulary or continuation space.
paragraphs.zh: 对被采样兄弟节点建立的类别分布对其 logits 或奖励的共同平移保持不变。 它可以对已观测的续写进行排序，但会移除它们共同拥有的价值。 当被采样的集合被视为一个封闭的选择集时，这样做是合适的。 然而，在大语言模型中，少量被采样的兄弟节点只覆盖续写空间的一小部分。 如果每个被观测的兄弟节点相对行为策略而言都是有用的，那么基于兄弟节点归一化的更新无法将它们一起提升。 TreeOPSD 转而为每个被观测的轮次分配其自身相对行为的伯努利目标，使共享策略能够在保留它们相对差异的同时提升所有有用的轮次。 每个目标描述了某个被观测轮次应相对其行为似然移动到何处。 这些目标并不构成在整个词表或续写空间上的归一化动作分布。

paragraphs.en: A tree whose rewards all coincide has q i = 1 / 2 q_{i}=1/2 at every turn, so in later blocks it pulls its own turns back toward π θ old \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}} , much as Learning without Forgetting distills the previous model’s outputs ( Li and Hoiem, 2017 ) . On-policy RL forgets less than SFT, and its forgetting tracks the KL shift on the new task ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) . TreeOPSD shares the on-policy sampling behind this result, and its teachers also stay within ρ \rho of 1 / 2 1/2 . RL post-training still forgets across task sequences, however, because KL measured on current-task data does not control drift on prior-task distributions ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . Mixing a few stored trees from earlier environments, together with their logged behavior probabilities, into later batches would extend the q i = 1 / 2 q_{i}=1/2 anchor to prior tasks without new rollouts. On the parameterization side, continual-learning methods mitigate the stability–plasticity dilemma through parameter regularization ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ) , fly-olfactory-circuit designs ( Zou et al., 2025b ; Zou et al., 2026b ) , and guided random projections ( Li et al., 2026b ) . FlyLoRA limits inter-task interference in LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) by using a frozen sparse random projection as an implicit router over rank-wise experts ( Zou et al., 2025c ) , and TreeOPSD applies to such parameterizations unchanged because it only reweights token log-likelihood gradients. The residual already accounts for drift among prompts within a batch (Appendix C.3 ), and a decorrelated parameterization would limit interference across environments that never share a batch.
paragraphs.zh: 一棵所有奖励都相同的树在每个回合都有 q i = 1 / 2 q_{i}=1/2，因此在后续的块中，它会将自己的回合拉回 π θ old \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}}，这很像 Learning without Forgetting 对先前模型输出进行蒸馏的方式（Li and Hoiem, 2017）。 同策略强化学习比 SFT 遗忘得更少，且其遗忘程度与它在当前任务上引起的 KL 偏移相关（Shenfeld et al., 2026）。 TreeOPSD 共享了这一结果背后的同策略采样，且其教师也保持在 1 / 2 1/2 的 ρ \rho 范围内。 然而，强化学习后训练在任务序列之间仍然会遗忘，因为在当前任务数据上测得的 KL 并不能控制先验任务分布上的漂移（Luo et al., 2026）。 将来自先前环境的少量已存储的树及其记录的行为概率混入后续批次中，可以在无需新 rollout 的情况下将 q i = 1 / 2 q_{i}=1/2 的锚点扩展到先前的任务。 在参数化方面，持续学习方法通过参数正则化（Kirkpatrick et al., 2017）、果蝇嗅觉回路设计（Zou et al., 2025b；Zou et al., 2026b）以及引导式随机投影（Li et al., 2026b）来缓解稳定性—可塑性困境。 FlyLoRA 通过使用一个冻结的稀疏随机投影作为对按秩专家的隐式路由器，限制了 LoRA 中的任务间干扰（Hu et al., 2022；Zou et al., 2025c），而 TreeOPSD 可以不加修改地应用于这类参数化，因为它只是对 token 对数似然梯度进行重新加权。 残差项已经考虑了同一批次内提示之间的漂移（附录 C.3），而去相关的参数化则可以限制那些从不共享批次的多个环境之间的干扰。

paragraphs.en: All runs use bfloat16 and SGLang on one eight-GPU node. Qwen3-4B uses FSDP. Qwen3-30B-A3B uses FSDP for Multi-Hop QA and FSDP2 for Deep Research, with rollout tensor parallelism of four on 96GB H20 GPUs. We train for 100 policy updates with AdamW, a constant learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and weight decay 0.01 0.01 . The Adam coefficients are ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (0.9,0.999) for Multi-Hop QA and ( 0.9 , 0.98 ) (0.9,0.98) for Deep Research. We use no auxiliary KL penalty or entropy regularization, and sample training rollouts with temperature 1.0 1.0 and top- p p 1.0 1.0 . paragraphs.en: We evaluate every five policy updates through step 80 on Multi-Hop QA and step 70 on BrowseComp-Plus, and report one checkpoint per run in that window. The training-turn curve averages the rollouts collected at each checkpoint. paragraphs.en: ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022 ) evaluates the shared initialization without parameter updates. GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) standardizes terminal rewards over complete rollouts from each prompt. GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025b ) replaces token-level importance ratios with a sequence-level ratio while retaining group-relative terminal advantages. TreePO uses the same initialize-then-expand trees, likelihood-weighted credits V i V_{i} , unique-turn reconstruction, prompt normalization, and optimizer blocks as TreeOPSD, but applies the fixed ascent coefficient V i / L x V_{i}/L_{x} throughout optimization instead of matching a finite posterior target. Every trainable method applies four actor optimizer blocks per collected prompt batch.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct（Yao 等，2022）在不进行参数更新的情况下评估共享初始化。 GRPO（Shao 等，2024）对来自每个提示的完整 rollout 的终端奖励进行标准化。 GSPO（Zheng 等，2025b）用序列级别的比率替代 token 级别的重要性比率，同时保留组相对的终端优势。 TreePO 使用与 TreeOPSD 相同的「先初始化后扩展」的树、似然加权的信用 V_{i}、唯一轮次重构、提示归一化和优化器模块，但在整个优化过程中应用固定的上升系数 V_{i}/L_{x}，而不是匹配有限的后验目标。 每个可训练方法对每个收集到的提示批次应用四个智能体优化器模块。

sents.zh: 每个可训练方法对每个收集到的提示批次应用四个智能体优化器模块。

paragraphs.en: GRPO and GSPO use G = 8 G=8 rollouts per prompt. TreePO and TreeOPSD begin with M = 4 M=4 complete trajectories, select N = 2 N=2 branch-anchor occurrences from each, and sample one fresh terminal suffix per occurrence. Keeping the roots gives M ⁡ ( N + 1 ) = 12 M(N+1)=12 terminal leaves. A continuation randomly starts from an intermediate prefix, so its expected generation length is roughly half that of a root rollout, and the expected cost M ⁡ ( 1 + N / 2 ) = 8 M(1+N/2)=8 matches G G . Appendix D.3 compares the methods at equal training time.
paragraphs.zh: GRPO 和 GSPO 对每个提示使用 G=8 个 rollout。 TreePO 和 TreeOPSD 从 M=4 条完整轨迹开始，从每条轨迹中选择 N=2 个分支锚点出现位置，并为每个出现位置采样一个新的终止后缀。 保留根节点会得到 M(N+1)=12 个终止叶子节点。 延续从中间前缀随机开始，因此其期望生成长度约为根 rollout 的一半，期望成本 M(1+N/2)=8 与 G 相匹配。 附录 D.3 在相同训练时间下比较了这些方法。
